data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of $5,921.697m. During 2019 there was an adverse prior-accident-year run-off (prior year deterioration) of $36.2m, driven primarily by International Financial Lines and International Property and Casualty, partially offset by favourable movements on Marine, Crisis Management, Energy Property and Wholesale Property & Casualty. The overall direction of prior year development for 2019 is an adverse strengthening, but the quantified movement is relatively small (~0.61% of opening gross claims outstanding).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 12 (Gross claims outstanding as at 1 January 2019 = $5,921,697k). Prior year movement taken from Note 5 narrative which states an 'unfavorable run-off deviation ... of $36.2m' but the note does not explicitly state whether this figure is gross or net of reinsurance; we have treated it as the prior-year gross movement (confidence 0.8). The claims development triangle (Note 13) is present and gross, but OCR/extraction produced partial alignment; development rows were reconstructed with best-effort alignment. All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and in millions.
